newsitem.title: UK: M.A.I.D up after positive press comment.
newsitem.headline: M.A.I.D up after positive press comment.

text.p: Shares in online information group M.A.I.D Plc rose to a four-month high on Monday after upbeat comment on the stock in the Financial Mail on Sunday, dealers said.
The paper said a recent deal with AltaVista, owned by Digital Equipment Corp., was a "powerful endorsement" of M.A.I.D's internet search programme InfoSort.

M.A.I.D said last week AltaVista would integrate InfoSort with its own AltaVista Search to produce what it said would be "one of the world's fastest and most accurate data retrieval engines for business applications."
The Mail report also highlighted recent share purchases by U.S. fund manager Fidelity -- which said on April 3 it held a total 4.14 percent stake -- and rated the stock a "buy."
M.A.I.D shares were up 8-1/2p at 212-1/2 by 1223 GMT in volume of 311,272 shares.
